claims.text: The span detector is part of the Stochastic Answer Network (SAN) architecture, which includes a lexicon encoding layer, a contextual layer, and a memory generation layer.
The span detector employs a multi-turn answer module and utilizes a BiLSTM for processing memory.
The architecture is designed to jointly optimize the span detector and a binary classifier for unanswerable questions.
